755 reviews. 4.7 stars. And somehow the line moves fast.

Tween's Kitchen on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is the Vietnamese restaurant locals and tourists agree on. That almost never happens. Real pho, proper bun bo, portions that make you reconsider ordering two mains.

Priced at $15-30 a person. No resort markup. Just good food done right.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
